locator: Manpower Tables 3-1 and 3-2, the 1899 column (F), rows 8–89
published_scope: Japanese residents in Japan proper, year-end estimate
definition: Published reconstruction, 21,779,426 male and 21,741,469 female Japanese residents. The source reports single years 0–79 and an open 80+ interval. The family-register observation has a different denominator.
opening_method: Combine the reconstructed single years from age 5 into five-year age bands. Use these national resident shares in each opening prefecture with integer largest remainders.
uncertainty: The year-end reconstruction covers Japanese residents in Japan proper. It excludes foreign residents and Taiwan. The opening controls use a separate total and prefectural resident weights. Prefectural age shares and error intervals are unavailable for this model.

locator: Annuaire statistique de Finlande 1910, Table 12a, printed p. 27, Total columns by sex. Table 4 gives the year-end control.
published_scope: Grand Duchy of Finland, year-end population as tabulated by the Central Statistical Office
definition: Counts from the totals columns of the age, sex and civil-status table. Half-open source intervals correspond to completed age bands.
uncertainty: The December 1900 statistical total is from a historical series with a different level from the January 1900 reconstruction. Changes in age and sex shares and differences in enumeration coverage are unquantified.
